== Notes ==
* This is the skill used by the [[Spirit of Blood Song]] that is summoned by the [[ritualist]] skill [[Bloodsong]], and not the ritualist skill itself.
* These attacks steal life for the spirits own benefit, not the ritualist who summoned it.
* The activation time and corresponding icon are missed in the skill tooltip.
